{"status":"complete","sceneId":"c0e30477-b124-4cd0-a7cc-cf80eee8d35c","title":"詢問是否在場與請求等待","context":{"text":"包含詢問是否仍在此處、說明來電時正準備出門的情況、提出稍作等待的請求，以及簡短的回應。","evidenceCueIds":["c1","c2","c3","c4"]},"translations":[{"cueId":"c1","text":"還在這裡嗎？"},{"cueId":"c2","text":"電話打來的時候，正打算出門。"},{"cueId":"c3","text":"能稍微等一下嗎？"},{"cueId":"c4","text":"好。"}],"utterances":[{"id":"e1e17e7a-0a36-4632-9480-e76a6e99d6ab","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":[],"decision":"basic_only","pointIds":[]},{"id":"1d42b2f0-998a-47ae-95f2-20dcdfa5e187","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":["c1"],"decision":"explained","pointIds":["p1"],"chunks":[{"id":"ck1","spans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":0,"end":7}],"meaning":"接到電話的時候"},{"id":"ck2","spans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":8,"end":18}],"meaning":"正打算出門"}]},{"id":"f97e5e66-c395-4c96-b5bf-9327cdbacec7","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":["c2"],"decision":"explained","pointIds":["p2"],"chunks":[{"id":"ck3","spans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":0,"end":2}],"meaning":"稍微"},{"id":"ck4","spans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":2,"end":9}],"meaning":"能等我一下嗎？"}]},{"id":"2a1025f6-e246-409f-89b5-8c232474cab3","meaning":"","contextExplanation":"","contextCueIds":[],"decision":"basic_only","pointIds":[]}],"points":[{"id":"p1","utteranceIds":["1d42b2f0-998a-47ae-95f2-20dcdfa5e187"],"category":"grammar","presentation":"core","title":"「〜ところだった」表示剛要去做某事","sourceCueIds":["c2"],"contextCueIds":["c1"],"explanation":"「動詞辭書形＋ところだった」用來表示過去某個時間點「正打算做某事」或「動作剛要開始」的狀態。在句中常伴隨突發事件（如本句中的來電），說明原定動作在即將展開之際受到了影響或中斷。","sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":8,"end":18}]},{"id":"p2","utteranceIds":["f97e5e66-c395-4c96-b5bf-9327cdbacec7"],"category":"usage","presentation":"core","title":"「〜てくれる？」表示請求對方為自己做某事","sourceCueIds":["c3"],"contextCueIds":["c2"],"explanation":"「動詞て形＋くれる？」是熟人或平輩之間常用的口語請求句型，語調上揚表疑問。字面意思是「能為我做……嗎？」，在日常對話中用來委婉拜託對方配合，比直接使用命令形更親切自然。","sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":2,"end":9}]}],"reusableItems":[{"id":"r1","pointIds":["p1"],"kind":"frame","sourceForms":[{"cueIds":["c2"],"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":8,"end":18}],"text":"出かけるところだった"}],"pattern":"[動詞辭書形]ところだった","examples":[{"origin":"ai","situation":"A詢問B是否已經吃午餐，B說明剛才正準備吃的時候被主管叫去。","dialogue":[{"text":"もうお昼ご飯食べた？","translation":"你已經吃過午餐了嗎？","pronunciation":[{"text":"もう","reading":"もう"},{"text":"お昼ご飯","reading":"おひるごはん"},{"text":"食べた","reading":"たべた"},{"text":"？"}]},{"text":"食べるところだったけど、部長に呼ばれちゃった。","translation":"剛才正準備要吃，但被部長叫過去了。","pronunciation":[{"text":"食べるところだった","reading":"たべるところだった"},{"text":"けど","reading":"けど"},{"text":"、"},{"text":"部長","reading":"ぶちょう"},{"text":"に","reading":"に"},{"text":"呼ばれちゃった","reading":"よばれちゃった"},{"text":"。"}]},{"text":"それは大変だったね。","translation":"那真是辛苦了。","pronunciation":[{"text":"それは","reading":"それは"},{"text":"大変","reading":"たいへん"},{"text":"だったね","reading":"だったね"},{"text":"。"}]}],"targetLineIndex":1,"targetText":"食べるところだった"}]},{"id":"r2","pointIds":["p2"],"kind":"frame","sourceForms":[{"cueIds":["c3"],"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":2,"end":9}],"text":"待ってくれる？"}],"pattern":"[動詞て形]くれる？","examples":[{"origin":"ai","situation":"A正在準備出門的行李，請求B幫忙拿一下桌上的外套。","dialogue":[{"text":"荷物をまとめるから、そこの上着を取ってくれる？","translation":"我要整理一下行李，能幫我拿一下那裡的外套嗎？","pronunciation":[{"text":"荷物","reading":"にもつ"},{"text":"を","reading":"を"},{"text":"まとめるから","reading":"まとめるから"},{"text":"、"},{"text":"そこの","reading":"そこの"},{"text":"上着","reading":"うわぎ"},{"text":"を","reading":"を"},{"text":"取ってくれる","reading":"とってくれる"},{"text":"？"}]},{"text":"いいよ、はいどうぞ。","translation":"好啊，拿去吧。","pronunciation":[{"text":"いいよ","reading":"いいよ"},{"text":"、"},{"text":"はい","reading":"はい"},{"text":"どうぞ","reading":"どうぞ"},{"text":"。"}]}],"targetLineIndex":0,"targetText":"取ってくれる？"}]}],"pronunciations":[{"cueId":"c1","segments":[{"text":"まだ","reading":"まだ"},{"text":"ここに","reading":"ここに"},{"text":"いるの","reading":"いるの"},{"text":"？"}]},{"cueId":"c2","segments":[{"text":"電話","reading":"でんわ"},{"text":"が","reading":"が"},{"text":"来た","reading":"きた"},{"text":"とき","reading":"とき"},{"text":"、"},{"text":"出かける","reading":"でかける"},{"text":"ところだった","reading":"ところだった"},{"text":"。"}]},{"cueId":"c3","segments":[{"text":"少し","reading":"すこし"},{"text":"待ってくれる","reading":"まってくれる"},{"text":"？"}]},{"cueId":"c4","segments":[{"text":"うん","reading":"うん"},{"text":"。"}]}]}
